findings.explanation: Gimbal-lock branch uses hard-coded epsilon 1e-12 to decide when pitch is +/-90 deg. Threshold is not in DriftSpec/changelog and only matters for synthetic poses like pose(pitch=90). Choice is arbitrary and could hide divergence between Euler-derived and quaternion paths.
findings.suggested_fix: Document threshold source or use more robust check like abs(abs(pitch)-90) < epsilon with comment linking to spec's gimbal-lock note.
